pages.text: High-tier materials needed to reach the Singularity.$(br2)There are seven Origins: Wisdom, Courage, Justice, Love, Hope, Temperance, and Faith. Each is also used to create Origin tools or Origin armor.$(br2)Gathering every Origin lets you proceed toward crafting the Singularity.

pages.title: Origins
pages.text: Origins are crafted at the Transcendental Table.
